book.name: Faisok
book.title: A Maana Faisok Sina Mu Yaamut Na Luuk A Lisan A Fataraguiaana Lagasai Xe Si Tiofilas

content: A Piran A Tiis A Faasaalan Si Ananaias Nare Safaira
Taasaxa saxa mataa, isina na Ananaias, xuvul pa naasana, na Safaira, re faasot pana saxa nexavala sire.
Nane tavai a mu yaamut pana faat, taasaxa nane pife tavai nari pana faat xapiak. Nane faxarang a saxano faat e na naasana a texaas sena.
Layaan na Ananaias fe lisan a faat xe si Pita, na Pita a fine, “Ananaias, xenaso no langai si Setan talo i taa fabas a xunus ima e voxo no bit a Vovau Xaradak pana mamareiai ina xavala?

Paamuina yaan no faasot pana, a nexavala aave ve siim e lamina yaan no faasot pana, a mu faat aave ve siim. A so ta mo a valam nano e no felamon malaan e voxo no vil a vilaana saat malaanabeꞌ? No pife bit a rabuna, no fo bit a Piran.”
Layaan na Ananaias a langaie nane poxo e femaat marasaxa. Nari aava ri langaie, ri mataut faagut sena fakasanaman aanabeꞌ.
E mui a mu xulau ri filimaan e ri maa xafute e ri yaase e ri fe xaafane.
Lamina awa talatul, na naasana savat. Taasaxa pife texaas sena so ta mo fo savat se lavana.
Na Pita fine, “Nabeꞌ a faat xapiak ina xavala aava me fo faasot pana, bo?” E nane suie, “Aang, a mamareiai ina xavala movoxo.”

E na Pita a xuuse, “Xenaso me faxuvul pana lamonan malaan? Naak rao me tafang a Vovau Xaradak sina Piran? Kaalum, a mu xulau aava ri xaafan na lavaam, naboxo ri taxa ulaamaan e ri taa xaafan nano sait.”
E fataapus, nane poxo maat. Nari mu xulau ri tingin nane maat e ri yaase e ri fe xaafane la ta lavana.
A mu rabuna aava ri namkai e xasano rabuna sait, ri langai sena e ri mataut faagut paaliu.
A Mu Yaamut Ri Vil Faroxoi A Mu Rabuna Xaves

A mu yaamut ri taxa lo vil a maana mo faꞌipul e maana mo ina gutan la palou ina rabuna. E mu rabuna aava ri namkai, ri fuuna faxuvul lana saxa nobina ina tang lifu lotu aava ri faꞌisine pana Bina si Solomon.

E nari aava ri pife namkai xo, ri pife lalamon temasaat pana faxuvul xuvul pari, senaso ri mataut ulaa ri tamaa maat. A tuuna, ri suai faagut sena mu rabuna aava ri namkai e ri pife kawaasan a faxuvulan siri.
E la maana yaan xapiak, a xakatan ina mu rabuna aava ri namkai, taxa lo molava et.

A mu rabuna ti Jerusalem ri langai sena maana mo a mu yaamut ri fo vile e voxo ri siak fasavat a maana rabuna aava ri giis e ri fe famati nari la vangana salan talo a xaxaalua i Pita i taa poxo xuluri layaan i taxa sangas et e ri taa roxo fulaa.
E a mu rabuna ti la nu bina falet la xasing vaxa ri lisanmaan a mu rabuna aava ri giis e nari aava mu vovau saat fo vao nari, xe si Pita e mu yaamut talo ri taa roxo e nari xapiak ri roxo.
A Mu Memai Ina Lotu Juda Ri Tivotan Fulan A Faisok Sina Mu Yaamut
A memai priis xuvul pana mu tauna aava mu Sedusi, ri savat sina mu yaamut xena tivotanaana faisok siri. A mu paamua ina lotu ri xinaas senaso a xakatan ina rabuna aava ri namkai, taxa lo molava et.
E voxo ri maa yot a mu yaamut e timin nari lana lifu ina fakasanaman.
Taasaxa la xunavung, a angelo sina Piran a savat siri e kas a matana lifu aave e lisan nari xe lamalei.
E a xuus nari o ri taa falet xe la tang lifu lotu xena xuus fatexaas a mu rabuna pana toyan xe vulai.

Nari, ri faxaꞌusi a kuusan sina angelo aanabeꞌ e ri laak xe lana tang lifu lotu la paanen paaliu e ri tangpat pana fepitaa fulaa. Layaan a mu paamua ina lotu xuvul pana mu tauri, nari aava ri xali nari pana Saniidrin, ri maa savat la lifu ina tiisan, ri feng a saxanofuna xe la lifu ina vipisan xena xelaana mu yaamut.
A rabuna ina faxatang a tang lifu lotu, ri fe savat pave, taasaxa mu yaamut ri malit. Ri fe xuus fatexaas a mu matalava e memai keptin siri pana
e ri kuus, “Maam fe savat pave la matana lifu ina vipisan e a matana xaxawa e a mu rabuna ina faxatang a lifu aave ri taxa waan. E layaan ri kase, piau ta rabuna lana.”
Layaan a mu memai priis e memai keptin ri langai a ferawaian siri, ri lalamon pana so ta mo naboxo i taa savat.
Layaan a mu matalava ri taxa fexuus, saxa mataa maa savat siri e a xuus fatexaas nari, “A mu rabuna aava mi fo yot nari lanef, ri taxa waan la tang lifu lotu laa e ri taxa fapiti fulan a rabuna.”

A mu rabuna ina faxatang a tang lifu lotu xuvul pana memai keptin siri ri falet e ri fe xel faroxoi a mu yaamut ulaa mu rabuna aava ri taxa langai sina mu yaamut, ri tamaa marala e tamaa soxoi nari mu Saniidrin pana faat.
Ri fatiginei a mu yaamut la matana mu matalava ti la Saniidrin e a memai priis a xuus nari,

“Maam fo kuus bukan nami o mi muta fepitaa fulaa pana isin aanabeꞌ. Taasaxa mi fo yuuf a rabuna xaves ti Jerusalem pana fepitaian simi. Naak mi taxa vubuk timin a maatan sina mataa aanabeꞌ xulumaam, bo?”
Na Pita e mu yaamut ri sui a ferawaian siri, “Nemaam taa usi a ferawaian sina Piran e pife sina mataa malaan setaara.
A Piran sina mu tamataara fo fatatoi faꞌuli na Yesus ti la maatan, nane aava nami fo punuxe layaan mi niile xuluna bolo.

E a Piran a xel faneie la pamuaan sina e tavaie pana vepen xena paamuian a maana mo xapiak e faꞌisine pana Nges ina Vil Fatato talo a mu Israel ri taa toxan a yaan xena puxaana vilaana siri. E nane taa lamon tapin a mu vilaana saat siri.
Nemaam xuvul pana Vovau Xaradak aava Piran a tavai a mu rabuna aava ri namkai pana, nemaam xapiak, maam xalum a maana mo aanabeꞌ e maam taxa fepitaa pana sait.”
Layaan ri langai a ferawaian sina mu yaamut ri marala faagut e ri buk punuk nari.
Taasaxa saxa Ferasi, a isina Gameliel, a mataa ina fepitaa pana vuputkai sina Piran, nane tigina la palou iri. A rabuna, ri suai sena e voxo ri fuuna langaie e nane kuus, “Feng nari xe lamalei.”
Ri falet xe lamalei e mui na Gameliel a kuus, “Mu Israel, mi taa lalamon faroxo pana so ta mo mi taa vile pari.
Lumua, na Teudas a savat e a kuus o nane sang a matalava e faasilak a mu rabuna 400 ri usie. Taasaxa, xasanofuna ri punuxe e a mu rabuna aava ri usie ri tapisi fepatok e a faisok sina xo malit.
Lami Teudas, lana yaan ina fakataana rabuna, na Judas ti Galili a savat e paamuian a saxano rabuna e ri tisui a gavamen ti Rom. Nane sait, ri punuxe e a mu fangaasik sina, ri sinuf.
E voxo, ne taa fasei nami, taꞌulan a mu rabuna aanabeꞌ. Tamo ri taxa faisok lapaana gutan sina mataa mon, malaan sena rovaat aava taara mo kuusane, a faisok siri i taa poxo.
Taasaxa tamo ri taxa faisok lapaana gutan sina Piran, mi pife fexaxaas sena faꞌonam nari senaso mi taa tingin nami xa mi taxa tisui a Piran.”

E voxo, a mu rabuna ri langai a ferawaian si Gameliel e ri xel falak fulan a mu yaamut e ri saaxan nari. Lamina saaxanaan nari, a mu matalava ri fasei faagutan nari o ri muta fepitaa fulaa pana isi Yesus e ri feng tapin nari.

A mu yaamut ri taꞌulan a lifu ina tiisan e ri merao. Ri texaas o a Piran a faamamaas pana vilaana siri senaso nane turoxo o nari, ri taa siak a maasaxan malaan sena vilaana a rabuna ri mo vile se Yesus.
La maana yaan lana tang lifu lotu e la maana mu lifu sina rabuna, a mu yaamut ri taxa lo fepitaa e ri kuusan fasavat a Lagasai Roxo o na Yesus ve a Mataa Failai sina Piran.
